meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能助手具备部署网站的能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望智能助手能自动把网站发布上线
copy.tagline_en: Enable your assistant to deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to deploy websites for you

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能直接部署 Web 应用到 Vercel。它会安装 Vercel 命令行工具，并自动配置 Vercel 的 API 凭据，使 Claude 无需你手动操作即可执行部署、查看部署列表等命令。
howto.when: 当用户要求 agent 将 Web 应用部署到 Vercel，或提出查看部署列表、检查认证等 Vercel 相关操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我把当前项目部署到 Vercel 的生产环境。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Vercel CLI 执行部署。

say.text: 看看这个项目在 Vercel 上的所有部署记录。
say.note: Claude 会调用 vercel ls 列出部署。

say.text: 验证一下我现在连的 Vercel 账号是谁。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude deploy web apps to Vercel directly. It installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and auto-configures Vercel API credentials, so Claude can run deployment and listing commands without manual token handling.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks the agent to deploy a web app to Vercel or perform related operations such as listing deployments, checking account info, etc.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude runs vercel deploy with production flag.

say_en.text: Show me recent Vercel deployments for this project.
Which Vercel account am I using?
